top_news.title: Elevenlabs makes Music v2.5 available via app and API with free and pro tier options
top_news.dek: ElevenLabs has released Music v2.5, featuring improved audio fidelity and a model trained exclusively on licensed music.
top_news.brief: The updated model shows significant preference gains in blind tests across genres like R&B, Soul, and orchestral music. Users retain rights to generated tracks, with the Pro tier offering 400 lossless downloads per month. Commercial use is permitted, though the free tier requires attribution.
top_news.image_alt: ElevenLabs Music v2.5 interface showing audio waveform generation

top_news.title: CUDA for AMD on Windows
top_news.dek: A new project enables CUDA-targeted Windows applications to run on AMD GPUs using ZLUDA and ROCm/HIP.
top_news.brief: The Speedstu/CUDA-for-AMD-Windows repository provides a reproducible stack for executing CUDA-based workloads on AMD hardware. By leveraging ZLUDA and the ROCm/HIP stack, the project aims to bridge the compatibility gap for Windows users running CUDA-dependent software on non-NVIDIA GPUs.
top_news.image_alt: Windows and AMD GPU compatibility badges

top_news.title: A Princeton Researcher Proposes Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) that Carries Decoder State across Every Token, Fixing 96 Blocks per Token with Unbounded Temporal Depth
top_news.dek: The Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) architecture introduces unbounded temporal depth by carrying decoder state across every token.
top_news.brief: Proposed by Yifan Zhang, the RLT architecture pairs a causal encoder with a recurrent decoder. It maintains hidden states and layerwise sliding-window attention caches across prompt and response tokens without resetting at serving boundaries. The configuration utilizes 96 logical blocks per token to enable persistent state management.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram illustrating the Recurrent Looped Transformer architecture

primary.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei wants AI speed limits before self-improvement outpaces human control
primary.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is calling for a controlled slowdown in AI development. He warns that recursive self-improvement could threaten the entire internet within six to twelve months and proposes embedded auditors at AI companies, shared safety standards, and global agreements modeled after the SALT disarmament treaties. His warning comes just ahead of what could be the largest initial public offering in history. primary.title: GPT-6 Astra appears to show a "step change" in spatial reasoning based on early benchmarks
primary.summary: In a new robotics benchmark, GPT-6 Astra shows major gains in spatial understanding.
